_what: One workflow the workflow engine runs for each case a gauntlet's generator draws (the e2e skill's generated cases): see its job. Its records and its condition's wake are made by read-data/derived-records.mjs.

payload.label: Run one drawn gauntlet case
payload.job: Run one case a gauntlet's generator drew, as the real call it stands for, and keep what it answered beside the case. A gauntlet keeps its axes, formulas, drawn cases and results in the person's own store, in that store's own form; the formula engine draws each case as one entry holding its number k, its words per axis, `call` (the input of one tools:list that has no effect) and drawn_by. When such an entry is added, its change wakes this run carrying the entry itself; this run makes that list call and keeps the whole answer with the case's k in the gauntlet's results, in the store's own language; a call the door refuses is kept the same way, as {error}, so a refusal is a result too.
payload.produces: One result row per drawn case: the real answer of the call the case stands for.

fact.description: The workflow-chosen fact that woke this run: where (the vault name of the store), table_name (what changed, in the store's own name), op, key, and after: the drawn case as JSON text

fires_when.label: a drawn gauntlet case is added
fires_when.evidence: Written on 2026-11-18 for the e2e skill's generated cases (W0.3); on 2026-11-18 it stopped naming a table pattern and a change table (rule nothing-shared-is-coupled-to-a-store): it fires on any added entry the formula engine drew (it carries drawn_by), told by whatever store keeps the cases.

match.condition: a drawn gauntlet case is added

steps.title: Read the drawn case from the change
steps.do: Parse input.fact.after (JSON text): it is the drawn case, {k, words, call, drawn_by}. If after is missing (the case was too big to carry in the fact), read the entry whose key is input.fact.key from input.fact.table_name in the store named by input.fact.where, in that store's own language. Submit the case.

steps.title: Make the call the case stands for
steps.do: Make the one tools:list call the case's call holds, exactly as written, and keep its whole answer; when the door refuses it, keep {error: the refusal's words} instead.

steps.title: Keep the answer beside the case
steps.do: In the store named by input.fact.where, in its own language, keep the answer as the result of case k in the gauntlet's results, the object kept beside the gauntlet's cases (for cases named <gauntlet>_cases, the results are <gauntlet>_results; the person's own store may say otherwise), with run_by workflow:run-one-drawn-gauntlet-case. A result already kept for k is replaced by this one. Read it back and submit what was kept.
